summary: Completes Task 089 with append-only historical FX facts/evidence, exact executable conversion, an additive Connector SDK FX reader and a conformance-qualified Bank of Russia reference provider without implicit inversion or stale fallback.

impacts.evidence: FX reference facts are global non-tenant market data, while reporting/settlement/payment consumers remain tenant/workspace scoped and retain only immutable conversion references in their own lineage.

Persisted FX facts/evidence contain currency, exact decimal, bounded source/reference and timestamps only; provider fixtures are synthetic and no customer PII, credential, query string or raw financial payload is copied into reference storage.
No existing public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is removed or changed; Task 089b implements the already-declared FX boundary through internal/provider ports and preserves prior schemas.
No existing EventBus schema is changed. The additive finance.fx_rate.published.v2 contract from 089a remains compatible; persistence does not rewrite v1 events.

Connector SDK v1 gains only an additive capability-specific FXRateReader/observation request; frozen root Connector and Runtime interfaces stay unchanged, and cbr-fx imports only the approved Connector SDK prefix.

Expand-only migration 000040 adds append-only global fx_rate_facts, fx_resolution_evidence and fx_conversion_records with mutation-reject triggers; migration catalog checksum/dependency is explicit and no existing table is rewritten.

The CBR provider is no-auth/read-only, provider code has no direct SQL/Core/network authority, source references exclude credentials/query strings, stale/missing data fails closed and cache can only reference persisted facts.

Cross-currency derivation is enabled only through explicit rate type, as-of, source precedence, freshness, rounding, triangulation and minor-unit policy; there is no unsourced mutable current-rate override path.

Every resolution persists candidates, precedence and selected fact; every conversion persists full snapshot, source scale, resolution evidence IDs and digest, and reporting/payment reconciliation expose conversion-record references.

Stable conversion IDs make retries immutable/idempotent, persisted facts precede cache selection, conflicting content is rejected, and payment reconciliation fails explicitly when historical FX is unavailable or unevidenced.
No webhook contract changes. CBR egress is behind a host-injected typed read transport and provider code cannot open its own network connection.

Missing, stale, provider-unavailable and source-contract failures are distinct boundaries; deployment may measure resolution/cache/provider latency without logging raw credentials or finance payloads.

Provider routing/cache can be disabled without losing immutable facts; rollback leaves additive append-only tables intact for historical reproducibility and old same-currency consumers continue to operate.

Unit tests cover exact big-integer conversion/rounding, stale/cache persistence, SDK-to-fact binding, reporting/reconciliation evidence and CBR nominal/no-inverse behavior; Task-064 cbr-fx conformance passes all 13 checks and migration/architecture gates cover durable boundaries.
